config.title: System Configuration
config.tagsDesc: Manage predefined tags available for projects.
config.tagsPlaceholder: Currently, tags are defined statically in the codebase. This interface is a placeholder for when tags are migrated to the database.
config.appSettingsDesc: Stored in Cloudflare KV. Changes may take up to a minute to propagate.
config.appSettingsSaved: Settings saved (may take up to a minute to propagate)
config.apiDefaultLimitHelp: Number of items returned when no limit is specified
config.apiMaxLimitHelp: Upper bound for the limit parameter
config.registrationEnabledHelp: When off, new sign-ups are rejected
config.autoBackupEnabledHelp: Creates a backup daily at 03:00 UTC. Backups contain credentials in plaintext, so leave this off until backup encryption is in place
config.autoBackupKeepCountHelp: Backups beyond this count are deleted oldest-first (manually created ones included)
config.driveBackupEnabledHelp: Keeps a copy of each backup in Google Drive so it survives a Cloudflare outage or account suspension. Run scripts/google-oauth-setup.mjs first and register the four values it prints as secrets
config.workerVarsDesc: Opens a pull request that edits wrangler.toml on GitHub. Changes take effect once the PR is merged and deployed.
config.varProtected: This variable cannot be edited from the admin UI
config.secretsDesc: Cloudflare Workers secrets. Values cannot be read back from Cloudflare, so you can only list names and overwrite or delete them. A two-factor code is required.
config.secretProtected: This secret cannot be changed from the admin UI
config.deleteSecretConfirm: This secret will be deleted. This cannot be undone:
config.secretNameHelp: Uppercase letters, digits and underscores (e.g. RESEND_API_KEY)
config.secretValueHelp: Cannot be displayed after saving. The value is never written to the audit log.
config.totpHelp: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app
config.mailFromAddressHelp: Must be on a domain verified in Resend, otherwise sending will fail.
config.mailFromNameHelp: e.g. ModParks. Leave blank to send with the address only.
config.blockedEmailDomainsHelp: List of domains to block (comma/space-separated, e.g. tempmail.com, 10minutemail.com)
config.ddosStatusDesc: Status of automated DDoS protection using Cloudflare WAF custom rules.
config.ddosManualControlDesc: In case of sudden load, administrators can manually turn on WAF protection immediately. WAF will disable automatically after the specified time.
config.ddosActivatedSuccess: Under Attack Mode manually enabled for {minutes} minutes.
config.ddosThresholdRequestsHelp: Attack evaluation is triggered when request count exceeds this threshold
config.ddosThresholdDownloadRatioHelp: Ratio of /api/download requests to total requests
config.ddosThresholdTopSlugRatioHelp: Ratio of the most accessed slug requests to total requests
config.ddosThresholdIpRepeatRateHelp: Average request count per IP address (total requests / unique IPs)
config.ddosDefaultProtectionDurationHelp: Duration of protection when triggered automatically (ms, e.g., 600000 = 10 mins)
config.rewardSettingsDesc: Shares site revenue with creators as points. The pool is what remains after costs and reserve are deducted from settled revenue.
config.creatorRewardEnabledHelp: While off, monthly calculation, distribution and payouts are all halted
config.rewardOptInByDefault: Opt new users in by default
config.rewardOptInByDefaultHelp: Off is recommended. Since payouts involve real money, users should opt in themselves
config.rewardPayoutRatioAdsHelp: Portion of net ad profit paid out to creators (0-1)
config.rewardPayoutRatioSubHelp: Portion of net subscription profit paid out to creators (0-1)
config.rewardReserveRatioHelp: Portion of net profit held back as reserve, absorbing revenue drops and retroactive ad deductions
config.rewardReserveFloorMinorHelp: If the reserve falls below this, calculation halts and admins are notified
config.rewardMonthlyCapMinorHelp: Upper bound on total monthly rewards. 0 means unlimited
config.rewardWeightViewHelp: Score = page views x this value + downloads x download weight
config.rewardWeightDownloadHelp: How many page views one download counts as
config.rewardMaxProjectShareBpsHelp: Maximum share a single project can take; the excess is redistributed (e.g. 2000 = 20%)
config.rewardMinPayoutPointsHelp: Allocations below this are carried over to the next month instead of being granted
config.payoutMinPointsHelp: A floor is needed because fees dominate small payouts
config.payoutAutoLimitPointsHelp: Payouts above this are handled manually instead of being sent automatically
config.payoutPaypalEnabledHelp: Has no effect unless PayPal Payouts credentials are configured
config.payoutGiftcardEnabledHelp: Admins issue and deliver the codes manually
config.payoutGiftcardRateHelp: Gift card face value per point, absorbing purchase fees (e.g. 0.9)
config.translationSettingsDesc: Controls how descriptions are machine-translated. To stay inside the free tier, lower the daily run limit and the amount generated per call.
config.translationEnabledHelp: When off, no translation entry points are shown and the LLM is never called. Saved translations are still displayed.
config.translationModelHelp: Workers AI model ID (e.g. @cf/meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct-fp8-fast). Models that follow formatting instructions poorly cause more translations to be discarded.
config.translationMaxTokensHelp: Too low and the response is cut off, leaving that part untranslated. Match it to the input chunk size.
config.translationChunkCharsHelp: The body is split into chunks of this size. Smaller chunks are more reliable and generate less per call, but require more calls.
config.translationMaxInputCharsHelp: Descriptions longer than this are not machine-translated; authors are pointed to manual translation.
config.translationDailyRunLimitHelp: Keeps usage inside the free tier. Once exceeded, translation stops for the day and the original is shown. 0 disables it.
config.translationUserHourlyLimitHelp: Serving an existing translation does not count; only calls that reach the LLM do.

backup.title: Database Backup
backup.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete this backup file?
backup.confirmRestore: Are you sure you want to restore from this backup? All current data will be deleted and overwritten with the backup state. You may need to log in again after restoration.
backup.restoreWarning: WARNING: Restoring the database will overwrite all current data. You will also need to log in again with an admin account contained in the restored database.
backup.downloadCurrentDataDesc: Before restoring, save the current database to your device. This is required so you can roll back if the restore turns out to be wrong.
backup.currentDataSaved: Current data saved as {key}. You can now proceed with the restore.
backup.twoFactorRequired: Two-factor authentication must be enabled to restore. Enable it from your settings.
backup.driveMirrorFailed: Backup to R2 succeeded, but the copy to Google Drive failed: {error}
backup.driveNotConfigured: Google Drive is not configured. Run scripts/google-oauth-setup.mjs and register the secrets
backup.driveUploadFailed: Failed to save to Google Drive: {error}
backup.encryptionMissingTitle: Backup encryption key is not configured
backup.encryptionMissingDesc: Backups contain password hashes and API keys, so they cannot be created without an encryption key. Generate one with `openssl rand -base64 32` and register it as BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_KEY in the secrets settings. If this key is lost, existing backups can no longer be restored.
backup.mergeDesc: Imports this backup's contents without deleting current data. Deleted records will not be resurrected.
backup.mergeReviewNote: Differences in tables that are unsafe to merge automatically (users, credentials). These are not changed by this run.
backup.restoreModeAllDesc: Deletes all existing data and replaces it entirely with the state at the time of the backup.
backup.restoreModeDownloadsDesc: Deletes nothing. Only restores project and version download counts that were inflated by DDoS or similar.
backup.restoreModeTablesDesc: Clears only the selected tables and restores them from the backup.

usage.description: Review request volume and download counting

periodNote.free: Free resets daily and stops serving once the quota runs out. Showing today.
periodNote.paid: Paid is billed monthly once the included quota is exceeded. Showing this month.

usage.quotaUnset: No quota configured, so no ratio is evaluated.

notice.free: Consumption is running ahead of the expected pace.
notice.paid: Consumption is running ahead of the expected pace.

warning.free: Over 60% of today's quota. Act while the admin UI still works.

critical.free: Over 80% of today's quota. The admin UI stops working once it runs out.
critical.paid: Included quota exceeded. Additional charges are accruing.

usage.countedNote: The gap between requests and counted downloads comes from author self-downloads, protection mode, bots, and deduplication. If bot downloads stay at zero, bot detection may be unavailable.
usage.settingsHelp: Quota values change when pricing is revised. Check the Cloudflare pricing page before entering them. Saving also records the check date.
usage.planHelp: Free resets daily and stops serving when exceeded; Paid is billed monthly.

quotaRequestsHelp.free: Requests per day. Set 0 to skip ratio evaluation.
quotaRequestsHelp.paid: Requests per month. Set 0 to skip ratio evaluation.

usage.budgetHelp: Monthly amount tolerated beyond the included quota. Setting 0 makes even a few yen trigger warnings.
usage.measurementMissing: Cloudflare measurements are unavailable. Quota evaluation and budget alerts do not run without them.

analyticsFailure.neverRun: No fetch has run yet. Check that the daily cron is running.
analyticsFailure.lastOkButEmpty: The last fetch succeeded but returned no rows for the period.
analyticsFailure.envUnavailable: Could not read environment variables / bindings.
analyticsFailure.graphqlErrors: The Analytics API returned errors. Check the token's permissions (Account Analytics read).
analyticsFailure.httpError: The Analytics API returned an unexpected response.
analyticsFailure.networkError: Could not reach the Analytics API.

usage.sampledNote: The sampled figure comes from internal aggregation and undercounts, since some batches are discarded before being flushed. It is not used for quota evaluation.
usage.ownNote: The quota is account-wide, so a spike in another project takes ModParks down with it. Evaluation uses the account total; the breakdown is here to tell where the load comes from.

runtime.title: Service controls
runtime.description: Switch the site-wide operating mode and stop individual features here. A smaller blast radius means faster recovery.

featureHelp.upload: Stops new version uploads. Existing files stay downloadable.
featureHelp.jarAnalysis: Stops only the JAR analysis on upload. Uploads still work and analysis can be re-run later.
featureHelp.download: Stops downloads served through ModParks. External distribution links remain.
featureHelp.comment: Stops new comments. Existing comments stay visible.

runtime.reasonHelp: Record why it is being disabled. This is what tells you later whether it is safe to re-enable.
runtime.modeHelp: Changes site-wide behaviour. Prefer feature switches when they suffice — a smaller blast radius means faster recovery.

modeDesc.NORMAL: Everything runs according to the feature switches.
modeDesc.STATIC: Stops posting, uploads and downloads, and directs visitors to the static archive. Read APIs redirect to static JSON. The admin UI stays usable.
modeDesc.MAINTENANCE: Stops everything except the admin UI. Does not recover automatically.

runtime.durationHelp: Returns to normal automatically when the deadline passes, so a forgotten switch does not keep the site down. Maintenance does not auto-recover.
runtime.snapshotHelp: Generates the read-only archive data now. It is normally produced right after the daily backup; use this to check the contents before switching modes.

trust.description: Per-user trust values used as a moderation aid. Values are visible here only and are never shown to the user.
trust.disclaimer: Trust values are advisory. Base bans and removals on the individual events, not on this number.

detail.title: Trust credit detail
detail.overrideNotice: This tier was set manually by an admin (derived from score: {derived})
detail.frozenNotice: Frozen: automatic credits are paused. Penalties still apply.
detail.ledgerHint: "Raw" is the value at record time; "current" is its effect today after decay.

adjust.title: Adjust score manually
adjust.hint: Records a manual event in the ledger rather than overwriting the score.

bulkAdjust.title: Bulk Adjust Score for Selected Users
bulkAdjust.hint: Add manual events to the ledgers of all checked users.

override.title: Override tier
override.hint: Pins the tier independently of the score. Overusing this makes trust values meaningless.

freeze.title: Freeze
freeze.hint: Pauses automatic credits only. Penalties still apply.

recompute.title: Recompute
recompute.hint: Rebuilds this user's score from the ledger after changing coefficients.

reverse.title: Reverse event
reverse.hint: Invalidates this row. It appends a reversal rather than deleting, so history is kept.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.content:
These Terms of Service govern the use of ModParks (the "Service") and the relationship between the operator and users. By using the Service you agree to these terms.

## 1. Scope
These terms apply to all use of the Service. Notices and guidelines posted on individual pages form part of these terms.

## 2. Operator
- Operator: ModParks operator (Pitan76)
- Contact: admin@pitan76.net

## 3. Accounts
- You are responsible for keeping your account secure and must not let others use it.
- Minors may use the Service with the consent of a parent or guardian. Consent is required for features involving money, such as reward payouts.
- We may suspend or delete an account that was registered with false information or that breaches these terms.
- You can close your account at any time from the settings page. Personal data is then handled as described in the Privacy Policy.

## 4. Content you submit
- Copyright in the files, descriptions, comments and other material you submit ("your content") stays with you or the rightful owner. We do not acquire it.
- You grant us a royalty-free licence to use your content as needed to run the Service: storing, copying, distributing, caching, generating thumbnails and recipe images, showing it in listings and search results, and quoting it in announcements.
- You confirm that you hold the rights needed to submit your content and that it does not infringe anyone else's rights.
- You must state the applicable licence accurately for each project you publish.

## 5. Prohibited conduct
- Breaking the law
- Submitting content that infringes copyright or other rights, including redistributing someone else's mod without permission
- Uploading malware, spyware, or other harmful programs
- Distributing modified versions of the Minecraft client or server itself
- Harming other users or third parties, harassment, or abusive behaviour
- Manipulating download counts, likes, or reward allocation
- Interfering with the operation of the Service, or placing excessive load on it
- Submitting content entirely unrelated to the purpose of the Service (sharing Minecraft-related content)
- Spamming or impersonating others

## 6. Reporting an infringement
If you believe your rights are being infringed, contact admin@pitan76.net. You do not need an account. Please include:
- The URL of the page concerned
- The right you believe is infringed, and evidence that you hold it
- Why you believe it is infringed
- Your contact details (name and email address)

We review each report and, where we consider it necessary, remove or unpublish the content. We may notify the person who submitted it and give them an opportunity to respond. We are not a court and do not make final determinations of ownership.

## 7. Removal and account measures
We may remove or unpublish content, or suspend or delete an account, without prior notice where:
- These terms have been breached
- The content infringes, or appears to infringe, someone else's rights
- A file is judged dangerous by our scanning
- Required by law or by a request from a public authority

## 8. Creator rewards
- Rewards share part of the Service's advertising revenue with creators as points, based on usage. They are not payment for selling mods.
- How points are calculated, the periods covered, and payout methods and conditions are published on the rewards page and may change.
- Points obtained through manipulation may be revoked.
- Points cannot be transferred or sold between users.
- You are responsible for any tax filing and payment arising from points you receive.
- We may suspend or end the reward programme depending on revenue. If we end it, we will announce this on the Service together with how outstanding points will be handled.

## 9. Changes, interruption and termination
We may change, interrupt, or end the Service. Except in an emergency, we will announce termination on the Service. You can export your data in advance.

## 10. Disclaimer
- The Service is provided as is. We do not warrant that submitted content is safe, accurate, useful, or fit for any particular purpose.
- You use downloaded files at your own risk.
- We are not liable for loss arising from use of the Service, except where caused by our intent or gross negligence.
- Disputes between users, or between a user and a third party, are to be resolved between those parties.

## 11. Relationship with Minecraft
This is an unofficial service and is not associated with Mojang Studios or Microsoft Corporation. Minecraft is a trademark of Mojang Studios. The Service is not approved by, sponsored by, or operated by those companies.

## 12. Changes to these terms
We may change these terms to reflect changes in law or in the Service. We will announce the revised terms and the date they take effect on the Service. Using the Service on or after that date means you accept the revised terms.

## 13. Governing law and jurisdiction
These terms are governed by Japanese law. Any dispute between the operator and a user concerning the Service is subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the Osaka District Court, Sakai Branch, or the Sakai Summary Court, depending on the amount in dispute, as the court of first instance.

Effective: 15 August 2026

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content:
ModParks ("we", "the site") sets out below how we handle personal information.

## 1. Operator and contact
- Operator: ModParks operator (Pitan76)
- Contact: admin@pitan76.net

Questions about personal data, requests for disclosure, and complaints are handled at the address above.

## 2. Information we collect
- Account information: email address, username, display name, profile image, credentials (passwords are stored hashed), two-factor and passkey settings
- Information from linked accounts: Google or GitHub account identifier, email address, display name, profile image URL
- Content you submit: projects, versions, uploaded files, comments, ideas, collections, and reports
- Usage information: IP address, user agent, access time, browsing and download history, and identifiers stored in cookies
- Reward information: point ledger entries and payout destinations such as a PayPal email address (stored encrypted)
- Notification information: push notification endpoints and keys, and your notification settings

## 3. How we use it
- Providing the service, creating accounts, and authentication
- Publishing and distributing submitted content
- Sending notifications and responding to enquiries
- Producing statistics such as download counts, and calculating and paying creator rewards based on them
- Detecting and preventing abuse, malware distribution, rights infringement, and excessive load
- Complying with law and handling breaches of the Terms of Service
- Maintaining and improving the service

## 4. Cookies and transmission to external parties
We use cookies to keep you signed in and to remember display settings. Information is also sent from your device to third parties for analytics (Google Analytics) and advertising (Google AdSense). The information sent, its recipients, the purposes, and how to opt out are described in our External Transmission Policy at https://modparks.pitan76.net/external-transmission

## 5. Disclosure to third parties
We do not disclose personal data to third parties without your consent, except:
- Where required by law
- Where necessary to protect someone's life, body, or property and consent is difficult to obtain
- Where disclosure of sender information is legally required in response to a rights infringement claim

## 6. Processors and their supervision
We entrust personal data to the following providers to the extent needed to run the service, and supervise them appropriately.
- Cloudflare, Inc. (United States): hosting, database, and storage and delivery of uploaded files
- Google LLC (United States): analytics, advertising, backup storage (Google Drive), and Google account linking
- Resend, Inc. (United States): sending authentication and notification emails
- PayPal (United States and local affiliates): paying out rewards
- GitHub, Inc. (United States): GitHub account linking

## 7. Storage outside Japan
All of the providers above are located outside Japan, mainly in the United States, and data may be stored on servers there. We take account of the data protection regimes in those countries and rely on our agreements with those providers and on the safeguards they publish.

## 8. Security measures
- Encryption in transit (HTTPS) and at rest (hashed passwords, encrypted payout details)
- Restricted administrative access with an audit log of administrative actions
- Rate limiting on authentication, submissions and downloads, and detection of unusual access
- Scanning of uploaded files, with distribution blocked for files judged dangerous
- Regular backups

## 9. Operator access to unlisted and private content
For projects set to unlisted or private (including drafts), archived files, and other non-public data, the operator is technically able to access the content. We state this plainly rather than claiming otherwise.
In practice we operate as follows:
- We do not look at this content in the course of normal operation.
- We access it only in these cases: handling a report from a user or rights holder, investigating abuse or a security incident, complying with the law, and responding to an outage or performing maintenance where it is necessary.
- When an administrator downloads a non-public file, the access is written to our audit log.
- Viewing content out of curiosity, to monitor users, or for any purpose other than those above is prohibited.

Unlisted means "visible to anyone with the link"; it does not mean the content is kept secret. Please do not upload anything you cannot afford to have seen.

## 10. Retention and deletion
We keep personal data for as long as needed for the purposes above, or as required by law. When you close your account we delete your account information and data that identifies you, except:
- Records we are legally required to keep, or that are needed to handle a dispute
- Information already published and inseparable from other users' content, such as quoted comments
- Statistics processed so that individuals cannot be identified
- Copies held in backups, which are erased as those backups expire

You can export your data from the settings page before closing your account.

## 11. Your rights
You may request disclosure, correction, addition, deletion, suspension of use, suspension of disclosure to third parties, and notification of the purpose of use, for your own personal data. Contact us from your registered email address at the address in section 1. We will verify your identity and respond as required by law. There is no fee.

## 12. Data breaches
If personal data is leaked, lost, or damaged in a way that risks harming users, we will report it to the Personal Information Protection Commission as required by law and notify affected users promptly.

## 13. Minors
If you are a minor, please use the service with the consent of a parent or guardian. Consent is required for features involving money, such as reward payouts.

## 14. Changes
We may revise this policy to reflect changes in law or in the service. Significant changes will be announced on the site.

Effective: 15 August 2026

externalTransmission.title: External Transmission Policy
externalTransmission.content:
This policy is published under Article 27-12 of the Japanese Telecommunications Business Act (rules on the transmission of user information to external parties). It describes the information sent from your device to third parties when you use ModParks.

## 1. Google Analytics
We use Google Analytics to measure how the site is used and to improve it.
- Information sent: URL of the page viewed, referrer, IP address, browser and device type, language setting, access time, and identifiers stored in cookies
- Sent to: Google LLC (United States) and its group companies
- Purpose: measuring and analysing site traffic, and producing statistics used to improve the service

## 2. Google AdSense (advertising)
We display ads through Google AdSense to cover running costs. Ad providers may collect information from your device when ads are served.
- Information sent: URL of the page viewed, referrer, IP address, browser and device type, ad impression and click data, and identifiers stored in cookies
- Sent to: Google LLC (United States) and its advertising partners
- Purpose: serving and displaying ads, measuring ad performance, detecting invalid clicks, and tailoring ads to your interests

For details on Google's use of cookies and ad personalisation, see Google's advertising policies at https://policies.google.com/technologies/ads

## 3. How to stop these transmissions
You can stop some or all of these transmissions:
- Disable or delete cookies in your browser settings
- Turn off personalised advertising in Google Ad Settings at https://adssettings.google.com/
- Install the Google Analytics opt-out add-on at https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout

If you disable cookies, some features of the site — such as staying signed in — will stop working.

## 4. Transmissions required to run the service
Information needed to provide features you asked for, such as keeping you signed in, remembering your language and theme, and blocking abuse, is sent to our own servers (running on Cloudflare). These transmissions fall outside the notification requirement, and the data is handled according to our Privacy Policy.

## 5. Changes to this policy
If the recipients or the information sent change, we will update this page.

Effective: 15 August 2026
